app.notes: Skills no longer get stuck unused because of mana (all classes)

changelog.notes:
Skills held back by a mana rule (ArchMage's 4, Chaos Avenger, Yami no Ronin, Great Thief, StoneCrusher...) no longer get stuck unused: after 15 seconds they're used as soon as they're ready
HP rules still apply (Void Highlord and Dragon of Time skills that cost HP wait until you have enough)

Smarter skill orders: the order carries on from monster to monster instead of starting over (Arcana Invoker no longer resets its cycle, Verus DoomKnight keeps its Doom stacks)
Arcana Invoker uses its full cycle again, including summoning The World
Built-in skill orders always wait for the next skill instead of firing whatever is ready

Bots hunt: when a monster isn't in your cell, the bot goes to the cell that has it
Less chance of getting kicked: no more asking the bank over and over, quest turn-ins that keep failing (reward at max stack, full inventory) wait and then stop with a message, and joining the map you're in keeps you in your cell
Quest items in your bank are taken out before accepting or turning in a quest
New bot checks: whether a quest was already done (one-time and story quests)
Skills: use a skill only while HP is above a value, or skip it when it's not ready
Skill orders built in for 30 top classes (Arcana Invoker, ArchMage, Legion Revenant, Verus DoomKnight, Void Highlord, Dragon of Time, Chaos Avenger, LightCaster and more): ChudBot uses the right order for the class you're wearing in every bot, even bots with their own skill steps, with HP and mana rules (Void Highlord and Dragon of Time skills that cost HP wait until you have enough)

Less lag on phones: a lighter way of drawing the game, and the menu and log do much less work in the background
GUI only (Options tab, Quality row): the game isn't drawn at all while you're logged in, only Chud Bot's menu, for the smoothest phone. Your bot and buttons still work
In GUI only, the game's questions (party invites, "Are you sure?" boxes) and your drops show up in Chud Bot's look, with Yes / No and Accept / Decline
Low quality also turns on the game's Max FPS 60, Static Player Art, Smooth Background and Custom Drops UI, and stops the game from raising its quality again
With Custom Drops UI on, bots now see and pick up drops even when the drop menu is closed
Bots skip drops you already have as many of as you can carry, instead of grabbing them again
Follow a friend is now in the Travel tab (under the quick map buttons)

Bot timer: total time on a bot until it finishes, in the notification header and the Bots tab (tap it to start over)
Stopping only pauses it; starting the same bot again carries on, even after closing the app
When the bot finishes: "Bot finished. Took 2:13:45 in total."
Follow a friend (Options tab): goes to their cell, and to their map when they leave; Pick lists the players in your room; turn on Auto attack to fight with them
Drops a quest you're on needs are always picked up, even with Other drops on Leave (the phone's drop tray can fail to accept them)

Classes tab works when you fight yourself (quests by hand), not only with a bot
The game ignores class changes mid-fight, so Chud Bot switches in the gap between fights
Towns and houses (nothing to fight) leave your class alone
Notification: ⏱ how long the current quest has taken (small, next to the percent), and "done in" after you turn it in

Every item the server gives you (drops, temp items, quest items, buys) is checked: if the game's drop window failed to add it, Chud Bot adds it, so no more restarting to see items
No more 1-second wait before grabbing drops, and "kill until I have X" goes straight to the next monster and stops the moment you have enough
Classes tab: your Default / Boss / Groups picks win over the bot's own Equip class steps
Classes in your bank work: they're taken out when needed (the pickers list them too)
Attack steps and Auto attack use your picked classes too

Fixed bought items not showing in your inventory until you restarted the app (the game didn't know which item Chud Bot bought)
This also stops bots buying the same item again and again because they couldn't see it
Items tab updates by itself when you get, buy, use or bank items

Fixed bots getting stuck at Buy: a Load shop right before Buy made the shop get asked for twice, and the game ignored the second time
Chud Bot keeps its own copy of the shop the server sends, so merge shops the game doesn't keep still work
Tapping Yes on the game's "Are you sure you want to buy" box: if the game doesn't send the buy, Chud Bot buys it for you
Drops, shops and buys from the server now reach Chud Bot after logging in and reconnecting (this also helps declining drops)

Fixed the game's "Are you sure you want to buy…?" box staying stuck after you tap Yes (even after changing maps)
Chud Bot closes it once the server has answered the buy, after 20 seconds, or when you change map

Items tab: new Shop view. Open a shop in the game, then tap Shop
Shows prices, and for merge items what they need (have/need, and if it's in your bank)
Buy goes straight to the server, so the game's merge window (black on some phones) never opens
Merge items in your bank are taken out first

Before buying, the bot checks your bank
If the item is already in your bank, it moves it to your inventory instead of buying another
If a merge item needs items that are in your bank, it takes those out first so the buy works

Fixed bots getting stuck when buying: buys go straight to the server (no more "Are you sure?" box blocking it)
If a buy fails, the log says why (no gold, locked, wrong shop...)
After 3 failed buys of the same item in a row, the bot stops with the reason instead of looping forever

The big menu no longer moves when you hold it: it always opens centered
The little CHUD button can still be dragged and remembers where you left it

Smooth button (Options tab, next to Walk speed)
Full phone power: steady top CPU/GPU speed and your screen's highest refresh rate (uses more battery)
Plus low quality, lag killer, hidden players, no animations and 30 FPS in one tap

Paste a MediaFire link and it finds the real file (also Google Drive, Dropbox, GitHub, Pastebin)
Any file can be a bot: .txt, .bin, .json, Notepad Unicode files, x.gbot.txt names
Small mistakes in bot files are fixed (comments, trailing commas, curly quotes, extra text); otherwise it shows the line and column of the error
Log colors: red = failed, yellow = small problem, green = worked

New look: Legion (Style tab, Look), Dage's Undead Legion
Black with electric blue Legion fire, skull sigil, steel buttons with blue glow, black horn corners and a blue logo (art made with ChatGPT from real Legion art)
Logo always fits above the version number

New look: Shadowscythe (Style tab, Look)
Black-purple stone with violet runes, glowing violet buttons, silver rims, spiked corners and a silver-purple logo (art made with ChatGPT)

New AQ look: Style tab, Look, AQ (gold + leather)
Boxy gold, red and dark buttons, AQ switches, leather panels, gold corners and a gold CHUD BOT logo (art made with ChatGPT)
Green-and-gold update banner
New app icon: the chud guy drawn in AQW style
Switch back to the Default look anytime

Check updates button in Log: tells you if you're up to date
What's new: this update log, from 0.4.0 to now
Update messages are green and start the update when you tap them
Items tab: sections by type (Classes, Weapons, Armors, Helms, Capes, Pets...) and a Type filter

Small notification: the bar matches the opened card (bot progress)
The farm count is pinned right, so it's never cut off
Shows "any monster" instead of *

Quests are accepted again after a disconnect, however you started them
Classes for bosses (1 target) and groups (2+ targets)
Auto attack enemies (Options)
Bot packets work like Grimoire: room id, room number and player name filled in

New app icon
Notification shows what the bot is farming (have / need) and your quest progress
Finished quests and items say Done and move to the bottom

Cleaner notification: text fits, one bar, picture inside the card
Notification colors follow your Style accent

Small notification back to normal size
Android 16+: fully open Live Update card on the lock screen
More info in the small notification
Clearing the app closes it fully, so it opens in landscape again (no more stuck portrait)
Close app button on the notification

Notifications and background running work (works around Android's add-on bug)
Pick which server to reconnect to (Bots tab)
Copy diagnostics button in Log, for fixing problems

Back hides the app instead of closing it, so the bot keeps going
Autostart button for Xiaomi phones

Renamed to Chud Bot
Drops decline properly, including items you already own
Checks for updates every minute
Live card on the lock screen: time, kills, gold earned
Stays silent in the background after a reconnect

Cleaner progress notification
Mutes the game when you leave the app, sound comes back when you return
Reconnects, goes home, then restarts the bot
Declines drops that aren't in the quest or the bot

GPU drawing for more FPS
Keeps running in the background with a progress notification

Remove all animations (damage numbers stay)
Pick up AC / non-AC drops and send them to the bank
Fixed overlapping menus

New look
Bot editor: change settings like the room number, and the commands (saved)
Classes tab: class per monster from your inventory
Public or private rooms
Smoother graphics

Update pop-ups without reopening the app
Style tab: colors, menu and button look

Bots update by themselves
Tap a .gbot file to open it in Chud Bot
Delete bots (with a "You sure?")

First Chud Bot: run your .gbot bots on your phone
Menu for bots, travel, options, packets, items, quests and the log
Import .gbot files from your phone
